description: These elegant Parisian apartments, ideally located on the 3rd floor with elevator, enjoy an exceptional location just steps from the iconic Galeries Lafayette. Their privileged location offers direct access to the best Parisian shopping addresses, an eclectic selection of restaurants, as well as the nearby Saint-Lazare train station.Consisting of six bedrooms, these spacious apartments are suitable for families wishing to enjoy a cozy and welcoming setting.The spaceMy Opera de Paris are 2 connecting apartments: Apartment 1 is broken down as follows: •⁠ ⁠Living room with sofa bed for two adults, HDTV, DVD, Wi-Fi internet connection, coffee table, carpet. •⁠ Open kitchen with refrigerator, freezer, oven, microwave, stove, dishwasher, coffee maker, kettle, toaster and everything you need to cook and eat. Several storage spaces.•⁠ ⁠Dining room with a rectangular table and chairs for 8. •⁠ ⁠Bedroom 1 with a 180 cm x 200 cm bed, wardrobe. Window overlooking the interior of the building.•⁠ ⁠Bedroom 2 with a 180 cm x 200 cm bed. Window overlooking the inner courtyard.•⁠ ⁠Bedroom 3 with two 90 cm x 200 cm single beds. Window overlooking the inner courtyard.•⁠ ⁠Shower room no. 1 adjoining bedroom no. 1 with walk-in shower, sink, hairdryer and toilet. •⁠ ⁠Separate shower room n°2 with sink, shower and hairdryer.•⁠ ⁠a separate toiletApartment 2 is broken down as follows: •⁠ ⁠Living room with a sofa bed for one adult, two armchairs, an HDTV, a Wi-Fi internet connection, coffee table, carpet, windows overlooking the inner courtyard.•⁠ ⁠Open kitchen with refrigerator, freezer, oven, microwave, stove, dishwasher, coffee maker (with capsules), kettle, toaster and everything you need to cook and eat.
